Pinned pre-remote metadata contains 147 results, 11 original source entries, 63 chapters and 6 appendices. All chapters/appendices/entries, prior edition and retained source/evidence catalog objects are deep-equal. All existing book/evidence files are protected. Original local pending checkpoints are retained as historical; visual scope is inherited from actual fixed root/A receipts, with zero new image inspection and no all-229-page close-reading claim.

Current aggregate and final publication identities become MAIN_VERIFIED only after actual gates. Original local current_code_identity is explicitly PASS_ACTUAL_LOCAL_UNIFIED_INPUT / NOT_THE_REMOTE_CI_INPUT. Metadata remembers pre-remote source-commit Git blobs. Fixed receipts -> updated source manifest -> updated dossier -> external terminal receipt; updated metadata points to terminal receipt by path only, excluding a self-hash cycle.

A saved plan command actually exited 0; missing actual context refusal exited 2 with zero repository writes. All four stdout/stderr byte bindings were independently checked. These are syntax/plan/refusal observations, not a successful actual-context dry run or remote acceptance.

limitations: Actual remote context, CI receipts, source/main tree snapshots and subsequent real dry-run/apply remain necessary. This review does not execute prepare/main, reconstruct metadata outputs, accept any CI run, or publish anything.
Actual frozen source payload already has separate independent CLEAR; this review does not repeat science, payload decompression, or local proof gates.
